title: Compress the second Schur-loss Bellman moment
objective: Find a PSD, leverage-aware compression of the second Schur-loss moment that closes a finite remaining-set Lyapunov basis and yields c_r(A)>=c mu at tractable depth.
acceptance_checks: Retains the leverage vector and child spectral-floor information.
Passes both the simple-null-mode and high-nullity structured asymptotics.
Improves on the exact H_1 barrier at n=3 and mu=1/5.
Does not multiply the two-step without-replacement inequality across dependent pairs.
